data.sub: Anupam Kher ki maa ne di Suraj Barjatya ki film ko manzoori.

chat.study: Exam mein itne number mil jayein toh maza aa jaye.

chat.say: Film aane se pehle review pakka PR stunt hai.

data.asar: Dadi-nani ka review sabse saccha hota hai bhai.
data.caption:
Suraj Barjatya ki nayi film ka pehla review aate hi internet par charcha shuru ho gayi hai!

✨ Anupam Kher ki maa ne diye 100 mein 100 number
✨ Release se pehle hi mila pehla review
✨ Family audience ke liye ban rahi hai film

Ab dekhna ye hai ki ye movie theatre mein kya kamaal karti hai!

Save kar lo, baad mein kaam aayega.
